_meta.usage: plates since 2009–2010 (flag and TJ at the left, then 1234 AB 01): type only the two digits at the right end of the plate
_meta.note: The region code is the last two digits: 01, 05, 10 Dushanbe; 02, 06, 20 Sughd; 03 Khatlon; 04 Gorno-Badakhshan; 07, 08 Districts of Republican Subordination. It is where the vehicle was registered, not where the photo was taken. A whole plate does not work here: the code is at the end, so type the two digits only.
_meta.miss_note: not a Tajik region code: a 1996–2010 plate (letter(s) and four digits with the code and RT in a box at the right; use `--kind plate-1996`), a green non-resident or red diplomatic plate, a whole plate instead of the last two digits, or a plate of another country (Kazakhstan also puts a two-digit region code at the right end)
source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_registration_plates_of_Tajikistan, section 'Codes' (unreferenced; translated from the ru article)
